---
title: "Apps to work with HMT data sets"
---



You can download these apps and use them on your own computer, or use the installations on github pages:


1. [*Iliad* + *scholia* reader](./iliad-scholia.html): select passage of the *Iliad* and view any *scholia* on the selected lines
1. [Cross-manuscript *scholia* reader](./all-scholia.html): select passage of the *Iliad* in a given version, and view passage together with *scholia* from *all* edited versions
1. [Facsimile reader](./va-facsimile.html): browse page images of the Venetus A, hover over indexed page to see textual edition
1. [Codex browser](./codices.html): browse pages of a codex, see indexed images and texts.
1. [Interwoven diplomatic/normalized reader](./editorial.html): read *Iliad* and *scholia* texts in diplomatic transcription with editorial normalizations in parentheses.
1. [Browse images](./images.html) from all image collections.
1. See [referential inconsistencies](./dse-check.html) in  editorial indexing


::: {.callout-note}
## Versions
Each app displays an individual version number. Github release versions refer to release versions of the entire repository.

For details of both github releases and individual app versions, see the [release notes](https://github.com/neelsmith/hmt-apps/blob/main/releases.md).

:::
